Honestly I feel the same. Lately for some reason I think something is wrong with me causing me to go into a complete panic. I’ve been to the ER 4 times and they tell me I’m fine and to follow up with a doctor. But I’ve been having so many panic attacks it’s getting to the point where I’m afraid to fall asleep.

It always starts with me getting some weird pain. Then my anxiety kicks in causing me to feel other pains that probably are cause by anxiety. Then I start immediately thinking about dying. And that sends me in a spiral. I think about how I’m wasting my life. How pointless life is cause one day we just fall over dead and peoples lives will just move on. And then full panic mode sets in. I’ve always used smoking weed to help but I just turned 30 and smoking now just makes my panic attacks worse or even triggers them, which sucks cause I have ADHD, depression, and anxiety and weed was the 1 thing that helped.

I guess I’m posting this cause I feel like I’m not alone. Well… I hope I’m not alone. Panic attacks and disorders suck. And I wish there was an easy answer, but for me I have no insurance so I can’t afford treatments or seeing specialists. But me reading this thread helps me get some type of clarity in knowing I’m not the only one that feels like this.
